Kīcakavadha
campūprabandha. a.. probably part of Bhārataprabandha. TCD. 1390N (inc.).

Kīcakavadha
yamakakāvya in 5 cantos (177 verses) on the episode of Bhīma's killing Kīcaka in the Virāṭaparvan of the Mahābhārata. by Nītivarman who was earlier than the 11th Cent. (q. by Bhoja in his Śṛ. Pra. an. Namisādhu in C. on Rudraṭa's Kāvyālaṁkāra in 1069 A. D. an. also in a. number of C.s on Amarakośa, an. later grammatical works an. C.s). See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa (1963). p.. 774, 806-7.
C.. VI. 83 (inc.). Dacca 33. P. 989. B. IO. 7060. J. Assam R. S. III. p. 120 (no. A. 7). Kāṭm. 7. L. 615. Nepal I. p. 75. RASB. VII. 5095 (inc.). SSPC. III. E. 1. Trav. Uni. C. M. 612N (inc.). Viśvabhāratī 2559 (a..).
